label: sdc02_4kings_c_03_fairybb_01
text: Since you passed my Elite Trial, you’ve earned\nthe right to challenge me to a battle![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_4kings_c_03_fairybb_02
text: But what do you want to do now? Ready to move\nstraight to it?[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_4kings_c_03_fairybb_03
text: No problem! I’ll be ready whenever you are.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_4kings_c_03_fairybb_04
text: Got it! No time to waste, then, right? Let’s get\nto our positions![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_4kings_c_03_clerk_npc
text: Don’t think our Lacey is just a cute face! She’s a\nforce to be feared with that Excadrill of hers.
